programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E1
programme.desc: Gina (Shenina Cinnamon) and Mutia (Fathia Izzati) are two friends looking for the existence of Celuluk, a spirit that usually lives in papaya trees or gedang renteng. Gina guides the procession of summoning Celuluk while joking until she is faced with an unexpected situation.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E1
programme.desc: Gina (Shenina Cinnamon) dan Mutia (Fathia Izzati) adalah dua sahabat yang mencari keberadaan Celuluk, sosok makhluk halus yang biasanya tinggal di pohon pepaya atau gedang renteng. Gina memandu prosesi pemanggilan Celuluk sambil bersenda gurau, hingga akhirnya ia dihadapkan pada situasi yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E2
programme.desc: Aya (Lutesha) is an influencer who is slowly losing her popularity. He decides to go on vacation to a resort in a coastal area to get away from the demands of his job in Jakarta. But the manager, Andhika (Nicholas Saputra), sends some products for review.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E2
programme.desc: Aya (Lutesha) adalah seorang influencer yang perlahan mulai kehilangan popularitasnya. Ia memutuskan untuk berlibur ke sebuah resor di kawasan pesisir untuk menjauh dari tuntutan pekerjaannya di Jakarta. Namun, sang manajer, Andhika (Nicholas Saputra), justru mengirimkan sejumlah produk untuk direview.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E3
programme.desc: When the earthquake occurred, Julius (Ricky Malau), a prisoner, received a message that his hometown was in danger of a tsunami. Julius is allowed to go home to help Mama Emola, his old mother, who lives alone. On the way to the village, Julius, accompanied by Nuri, a young female prison warden, witnessed residents disguised as evacuation officers robbing homes.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E3
programme.desc: Ketika gempa bumi terjadi, Julius (Ricky Malau), seorang narapidana, menerima kabar bahwa kampung halamannya terancam tsunami. Julius diizinkan pulang untuk membantu Mama Emola, ibunya yang sudah tua dan tinggal sendirian. Dalam perjalanan menuju desa, Julius yang ditemani Nuri, seorang sipir penjara perempuan muda, menyaksikan warga yang menyamar sebagai petugas evakuasi menjarah rumah-rumah penduduk.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E4
programme.desc: Arif (Landung Simatupang) and Yati (Engelina Prihaksiwi) celebrate their wedding anniversary by reconstructing their application photo in one of the corners of the Borobudur Temple.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E4
programme.desc: Arif (Landung Simatupang) dan Yati (Engelina Prihaksiwi) merayakan hari jadi pernikahan mereka dengan merekonstruksi foto lamaran di salah satu sudut Candi Borobudur.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E5
programme.desc: Heri (Ronny P. Tjandra) takes his daughter, Femi (Brigitta Cynthia), on vacation to his hometown in Bangka. He wanted to show the city that introduced him to the Bangka noodles he sold in Jakarta. Heri feels this is important, especially because Femi will continue the noodle shop business when he retires.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E5
programme.desc: Heri (Ronny P. Tjandra) mengajak putrinya, Femi (Brigitta Cynthia), berlibur ke kampung halamannya di Bangka. Ia ingin menunjukkan kota yang memperkenalkannya pada mi Bangka yang selama ini ia jual di Jakarta. Heri merasa hal ini penting, terutama karena Femi akan melanjutkan usaha warung mi tersebut saat ia pensiun nanti.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E6
programme.desc: Marsiti is a girl who dreams of becoming a bull race champion. However, he had to face various obstacles. His mother wanted to sell the cows that his father had inherited. He also refused to participate in the Karapan because women could not become a jockey. Secretly, Marsiti prepares a strategy to follow the Karapan event and proves she is also suitable as a jockey.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E6
programme.desc: Marsiti adalah seorang gadis yang bermimpi menjadi juara balap sapi. Namun, ia harus menghadapi berbagai rintangan. Ibunya ingin menjual sapi-sapi warisan ayahnya. Ia juga dilarang mengikuti Karapan karena perempuan tidak diperbolehkan menjadi joki. Secara diam-diam, Marsiti menyiapkan strategi untuk mengikuti ajang Karapan dan membuktikan bahwa ia juga layak menjadi seorang joki.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E7
programme.desc: Urip and his older brother Darto came to collect debts at Mak Sati's shop. The discussion about debt heated up after Darto implicitly suggested that Ambar, Mak Siti's daughter, be a courtesan. This resulted in a riot involving Mak Siti's neighbours until a heartbreaking tragedy occurred for Urip and Ambar.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E7
programme.desc: Urip dan kakak laki-lakinya, Darto, datang untuk menagih utang di warung Mak Siti. Perdebatan mengenai utang tersebut memanas setelah Darto secara tersirat menyarankan agar Ambar, anak perempuan Mak Siti, menjadi perempuan penghibur. Hal ini memicu keributan yang melibatkan para tetangga Mak Siti, hingga akhirnya terjadi sebuah tragedi yang memilukan bagi Urip dan Ambar.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E8
programme.desc: Employees of the Uma De Raffa resort, located in a fishing village, are pessimistic about its sustainability because it is empty and almost bankrupt. An investor came and became a new hope for them. The situation, which initially went well, turned complicated when the investor had a heart attack and died on the spot.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E8
programme.desc: Karyawan resor Uma De Raffa yang terletak di sebuah desa nelayan pesimistis terhadap kelangsungan resor tersebut karena sepi pengunjung dan hampir bangkrut. Seorang investor datang dan menjadi harapan baru bagi mereka. Situasi yang awalnya berjalan baik kemudian menjadi rumit ketika investor tersebut mengalami serangan jantung dan meninggal dunia di tempat.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E9

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E9
programme.desc: Diego (Daus Ulya) adalah seorang pria bertubuh kecil yang bekerja sebagai figuran dalam proyek foto prewedding bertema Snow White & 7 Dwarfs. Selama sesi pemotretan, Diego terlibat dalam percakapan intim dengan calon pengantin wanita, mempertanyakan keputusannya untuk menikah dengan pria pilihannya.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E10
programme.desc: Tells the story of a young mother who tries to enjoy her time by having a beautiful picnic in the middle of a pine forest. However, this never came to fruition because he was repeatedly interrupted by phone calls, video calls, and replying to messages for work and domestic affairs.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E10

programme.title: Zak Storm
programme.desc: Kisah tentang Zak, seorang remaja muda yang tersedot ke dalam Tujuh Lautan di Segita Bermud saat sedang mengikuti kompetisi selancar. Dia dijemput oleh kapal bajak laut bernama Chaos. Zack dijadikan kapten kapal Chaos, sehingga mengharuskannya untuk bekerja sama dengan pedang ajaib yang bisa berbicara bernama Calabrass guna menghadapi berbagai bahaya di negeri tersebut.

programme.title: Menggapai Ikatan Cinta S1 E1
programme.desc: Kunjungan ke lokasi syuting Ikatan Cinta adalah kegiatan paling menyenangkan bagi Diva. Sayangnya, Nada terus melarangnya melakukan hal yang berhubungan dengan Ikatan Cinta, tanpa alasan yang jelas. Nada juga memaksa Diva untuk rajin mengerjakan tugas kuliah bersama Fahmi, teman kecilnya.

programme.title: Pay Later S1 E3
programme.desc: Penunjukan Tika sebagai pegawai tetap di kantor pajak dibatalkan karena adanya pengkhianatan, dan posisi tersebut diberikan kepada Yuli, temannya. Tika, yang memiliki banyak utang akibat kebiasaannya berbelanja secara kompulsif, akhirnya mendapat pekerjaan di kantor rentenir, namun tetap mengaku kepada keluarganya bahwa ia masih bekerja di kantor pajak.

programme.title: Pay Later S1 E4
programme.desc: Penunjukan Tika sebagai pegawai tetap di kantor pajak dibatalkan karena adanya pengkhianatan, dan posisi tersebut diberikan kepada Yuli, temannya. programme.title: Bedah Rumah Lagi S4 E6

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E4
programme.desc: Gania, seorang pengajar di surfing course yang bersahabat dekat dengan Barata, murid sekolah seni yang hobi melukis. Gania kedatangan murid baru yang sangat cantik bernama Agnes. Kecantikan Agnes membuat semua pria berebut memacarinya termasuk Barata. Gania membantu Barata mendekati Agnes dengan sepenuh hati bahkan rela mengorbankan perasaannya sendiri.

programme.title: 4 Anak Rantau - Cewek Cantik Tetangga Kos
programme.desc: 4 anak muda yang merantau jauh dari kota kelahirannya itu adalah Eko, Nunu, Andi, dan Ucok. Mereka jadi anak kost yang sering mendapat sial atau istilahnya ngenest.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E1
programme.desc: Rini mengetahui fakta bahwa saudara perempuannya, Dewi, mengakhiri hidupnya sendiri. Melihat banyak kejanggalan dalam kematian saudaranya, Rini pun melakukan penyelidikan sendiri.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E2
programme.desc: Rini memulai penyelidikannya bersama Rangga dan Ami, orang-orang yang ia kenal di grup penggemar Dewi di Discord. Rini kemudian menelusuri alter ego Dewi, yaitu Dee Megami.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E3
programme.desc: Kesaksian Michiryu-Chan alias Mira membawa Rini pada akun User6619, seorang pelanggan HeroineHotties yang terobsesi dengan Dewi.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E4
programme.desc: Setelah Rini mengetahui identitas asli Haryanto, ia melakukan satu-satunya cara untuk mendapatkan fakta baru tentang Dewi.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E5
programme.desc: Sosok misterius yang memegang ponsel Dewi akhirnya terungkap. Sementara itu, Rini terjebak di apartemen Haryanto.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E6
programme.desc: Rini kembali pulang. Namun ketika ia ingin sejenak melupakan penyelidikannya, Rini kembali diteror oleh MGK6619.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E7
programme.desc: MGK6619 menyerang rumah Rini untuk mencari keberadaan ponsel Dewi. Rasa takut Rini berubah menjadi kemarahan.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E8
programme.desc: Rini akhirnya mendapatkan kesaksian baru dari Haryanto. Rini dan Haryanto kemudian menyusun kembali kronologi kejadian hingga mereka memutuskan untuk mendatangi tempat Dewi meninggal.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E9
programme.desc: Rini dan Haryanto bekerja sama untuk menemukan fakta-fakta baru langsung di lokasi tempat Dewi ditemukan meninggal. Seluruh kota tampaknya enggan membuka tabir misteri tersebut, kecuali satu orang.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E10
programme.desc: Kebenaran mulai terungkap. Rini akhirnya berhasil mengungkap semuanya, termasuk fakta bahwa Dewi terlibat dalam sesuatu yang lebih besar.

programme.title: Kartu Keluarga S1 E7
programme.desc: Gunawan akhirnya meminta restu orang tuanya untuk Sri. Sebelumnya, mereka menolak Sri karena statusnya sebagai janda dengan satu anak. Sementara itu, Yuni berencana kembali tinggal di rumah Ambardi bersama Ageng, putra semata wayangnya.

The Uncle's son also wants a piece of the fortune and coerces a small time thief into stealing the will for his wild scheme.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen

The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Bipolar Rock N' Roller S1, Ep 3
programme.desc: A raw and unflinching account of Mauro Ranallo's decades-long struggle with Bipolar Affective Disorder. The voice of WWE and Showtime Championship Boxing, Ranallo has called some of the biggest sports events in history - all the while fighting his own epic battles with mental health Follow his journey in this 3-part series, as he combats the stigma behind mental health issues and sheds light on what it's like being at the top of the industry despite seemingly insurmountable odds. Directed by Haris Usanovic with appearances by Floyd Mayweather Jr. and Conor McGregor. Episode 3 of 3.

programme.title: Bipolar Rock N' Roller S1, Ep 3
programme.desc: Kisah nyata dan tak tergoyahkan tentang perjuangan Mauro Ranallo selama puluhan tahun melawan Gangguan Afektif Bipolar. Sebagai pengisi suara WWE dan Showtime Championship Boxing, Ranallo telah mengisi beberapa acara olahraga terbesar dalam sejarah - sembari bertarung dalam pertarungan epiknya dengan kesehatan mentalnya sendiri. Ikuti perjalanannya dalam serial 3 bagian ini, saat ia melawan stigma di balik masalah kesehatan mental dan menyoroti bagaimana rasanya menjadi yang teratas dalam industri ini meskipun rintangan yang tampaknya tidak dapat diatasi. Disutradarai oleh Haris Usanovic dengan penampilan dari Floyd Mayweather Jr. dan Conor McGregor. Episode 3 dari 3.

programme.title: American Boogeyman
programme.desc: The intrepid FBI agents Kathleen McChesney and Robert Ressler, organize one of the largest manhunt in history to apprehend America's most infamous serial killer, Ted Bundy.

programme.title: American Boogeyman
programme.desc: Agen Kathleen McChesney dan Robert Ressler nan pemberani mengatur salah satu perburuan terbesar dalam sejarah untuk menangkap seorang pembunuh berantai paling terkenal di Amerika, Ted Bundy.

programme.title: Gravy
programme.desc: It's All Hallow's Eve. A trio of costumed misfits with very special dietary requirements seizes a Mexican cantina and force the staff to engage in a late night of gaming, food and libations. The only caveat is what's on the menu.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: A British nurse escapes an attack on her outpost. Hunted by a German-led war party, and with help from local warriors, she embarks on an epic journey to save a neighboring outpost.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Seorang perawat asal Inggris lolos dari serangan di pos terdepan. Saat ia diburu oleh kelompok yang dipimpin Jerman, ia memulai perjalanan epik demi menyelamatkan pos terdekat dengan bantuan dari pejuang setempat.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Cop Jack Stone robs a Russian mob bank to end in the same prison as the mob boss killing Jack's wife. An inmate helps him as does a reporter. Lots of fights.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Polisi Jack Stone merampok bank mafia Rusia dan berakhir di penjara yang sama dengan bos mafia yang membunuh istri Jack. Seorang narapidana membantunya dan begitu pula seorang reporter. Banyak perkelahian.

programme.title: Phoenix
programme.desc: Jean Grey begins to develop incredible powers that corrupt and turn her into a Dark Phoenix, causing the X-Men to have to decide if her life is worth more than all of humanity.

programme.title: Phoenix
programme.desc: Jean Grey mulai mengembangkan kekuatan luar biasa yang merusak dan mengubahnya menjadi Dark Phoenix, menyebabkan X-Men harus memutuskan apakah nyawanya lebih berharga daripada seluruh umat manusia.

programme.title: Death In Texas
programme.desc: Just out of prison, Billy Walker returns to El Paso to find his mom dying of liver failure but low on the transplant list. However, the border offers other, darker options.

programme.title: Timeline
programme.desc: A group of archaeologists get embroiled in an adventure where they must travel back in time to 14th Century France, to save their professor before the French battle the English at Castlegard. If they fail, they won't be able to return.

programme.title: A Cry From Within
programme.desc: After a devastating miscarriage, a family trades their city lifestyle for a quiet life in the country but soon find themselves at the mercy of a terrifying and violent manifestation.

programme.title: A Cry From Within
programme.desc: Setelah mengalami keguguran, sebuah keluarga meninggalkan kota dan pindah ke pedesaan untuk hidup tenang, tapi kehidupan mereka justru penuh dengan kengerian dan kekerasan.

programme.title: Frozen Ground
programme.desc: An Alaska State Trooper partners with a young woman who escaped the clutches of serial killer Robert Hansen to bring the murderer to justice. Based on actual events.

programme.title: Temple
programme.desc: Three American tourists follow a mysterious map deep into the jungles of Japan searching for an ancient temple. When spirits entrap them, their adventure quickly becomes a horrific nightmare.

programme.title: Temple
programme.desc: Tiga turis Amerika mengikuti sebuah peta misterius masuk ke dalam hutan di Jepang demi mencari sebuah kuil kuno. Saat sesosok arwah menjebak mereka, perjalanan mereka pun berubah menjadi mimpi buruk nan mengerikan.

programme.title: Outlaws And Angels
programme.desc: When outlaws on the lam invade the home of an unsuspecting, seemingly innocent, frontier family to hide out for the night, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues, leading to seduction, role reversal, and ultimately, bloody revenge.

programme.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: A highly advanced robotic boy longs to become "real" so that he can regain the love of his human mother.

programme.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: Seorang anak laki-laki robot yang sangat canggih ingin sekali menjadi “nyata” agar ia dapat memperoleh kembali kasih sayang ibu manusianya.

programme.title: Holy Ghost People
programme.desc: To find her sister, a young woman hires an alcoholic ex-Marine to help her infiltrate the Pentecostal Church of One Accord.

programme.title: Holy Ghost People
programme.desc: Demi menemukan saudarinya, seorang wanita muda menyewa seorang mantan Marinir pecandu alkohol untuk membantunya menyusup ke Gereja Pantekosta One Accord.

programme.title: The Haunting Of Sharon Tate
programme.desc: Pregnant with director Roman Polanski's child and awaiting his return from Europe, 26-year-old Hollywood actress Sharon Tate becomes plagued by visions of her imminent death.

programme.title: The Haunting Of Sharon Tate
programme.desc: Saat tengah mengandung anak dari sutradara Roman Polanski dan menunggu kepulangannya dari Eropa, aktris Hollywood berusia 26 tahun, Sharon Tate terusik oleh penglihatan mengenai kematiannya yang akan segera terjadi.

programme.title: Good Kids
programme.desc: Four high school students look to redefine themselves after graduation.

programme.title: Good Kids
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang empat murid SMA yang ingin membuka lembaran baru setelah lulus sekolah.

programme.title: American Boogeywoman
programme.desc: The early years of notorious serial killer Aileen Wuornos, who marries a wealthy, older man in 1976, only to inflict mayhem within her new family and Florida's high society.

programme.title: American Boogeywoman
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tahun-tahun awal Aileen Wuornos, pembunuh berantai terkenal yang menikahi pria kaya dan lebih tua pada tahun 1976, dan membuat kekacauan di dalam keluarga barunya dan masyarakat kelas atas Florida.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Young Blade Runner K's discovery of a long-buried secret leads him to track down former Blade Runner Rick Deckard, who's been missing for thirty years.

programme.title: The Cat In The Hat
programme.desc: Two bored children have their lives turned upside down when a talking cat comes to visit them.

programme.title: Super 8
programme.desc: During the summer of 1979, a group of friends witness a train crash and investigate subsequent unexplained events in their small town.

programme.title: Armored
programme.desc: A newbie guard for an armored truck company is coerced by his veteran coworkers to steal a truck containing $42 million. But a wrinkle in their supposedly foolproof plan divides the group, leading to a potentially deadly resolution.

programme.title: Armored
programme.desc: Seorang petugas keamanan baru di perusahaan truk lapis baja dipaksa oleh rekan kerjanya yang lebih berpengalaman untuk mencuri sebuah truk berisi 42 juta dolar AS. Namun, sebuah celah dalam rencana mereka yang dianggap sempurna memecah belah kelompok tersebut, yang berpotensi berujung pada situasi yang mematikan.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang, a young successor to a long line of Avatars, must master all four elements and stop the Fire Nation from enslaving the Water Tribes and the Earth Kingdom.

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal with separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes awry.

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Dua siswa SMA harus mengatasi kegelisahan mereka akan perpisahan setelah rencana mereka untuk mengadakan sebuah pesta berakhir berantakan.

programme.title: Men In Black: International (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Agent H and rookie M team up to face shape-shifting aliens. In a globe-trotting mission, they race to save the agency and the world from hidden threats.

programme.title: Men In Black: International (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Agen H dan rookie M dari Men in Black bekerja sama menghadapi alien penyamar manusia. Dalam petualangan lintas dunia, mereka berusaha menyelamatkan agensi dan Bumi.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Will and Jake Grimm are traveling con-artists who encounter a genuine fairy-tale curse which requires true courage instead of their usual bogus exorcisms.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Will dan Jake Grimm adalah penipu keliling yang bertemu dengan kutukan dongeng sungguhan yang membutuhkan keberanian sejati, bukan pengusiran setan palsu seperti biasanya.

programme.title: Bumblebee (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Bumblebee teams up with a teenage girl to protect the world while the Decepticons hunt him with the help of a secret agency.

programme.title: Bumblebee (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Bumblebee bekerja sama dengan seorang gadis remaja untuk melindungi dunia sementara Decepticons memburunya dengan bantuan agen rahasia.

programme.title: Pixels (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: When aliens misinterpret video feeds of classic arcade games as a declaration of war, they attack the Earth in the form of the video games.

programme.title: Pixels (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Para alien melancarkan serangan terhadap Bumi melalui video game setelah menyalahartikan sejumlah video permainan klasik sebagai sebuah pernyataan perang.

programme.title: Slender Man
programme.desc: Four high school girls perform a ceremony to summon internet boogeyman Slenderman. Once they see him, they can't get rid of him. And one by one, the girls are driven mad, die, or disappear.

programme.title: Slender Man
programme.desc: Empat siswi SMA menggelar sebuah upacara untuk memanggil hantu internet yang bernama Slenderman. Namun, si hantu tak dapat disingkirkan dan satu per satu dari mereka menjadi gila, mati, dan menghilang.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
programme.desc: When a threat emerges that puts Bird and Pig Islands in danger, Red, Chuck, Bomb and Mighty Eagle recruit Chuck's sister and team up with pigs to forge an unsteady truce to save their homes.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
programme.desc: Saat sebuah ancaman nan membahayakan muncul, Red, Chuck, Bomb, dan Mighty Eagle merekrut saudara Chuck dan bekerja sama dengan para babi untuk melakukan gencatan senjata demi menyelamatkan rumah mereka.

programme.title: Buddy Games
programme.desc: A group of friends reunite to play The Buddy Games, a wild assortment of absurd physical and mental challenges. In the process, they'll heal old wounds, right past wrongs and figure out the true meaning of friendship or die trying.

programme.title: Tropic Thunder
programme.desc: Actors filming a war movie are thrust into a real jungle conflict, unaware that the battles they face are not staged, leading to chaos and hilarity.

programme.title: Tropic Thunder
programme.desc: Para aktor yang sedang syuting film perang terjebak dalam konflik nyata di hutan, tanpa sadar bahwa pertempuran yang mereka hadapi bukanlah akting, memicu kekacauan dan kelucuan.

programme.title: Indiana Jones & Kingdom Of...
programme.desc: Set in 1957, it pits Indiana Jones against Soviet KGB agents led by Irina Spalko searching for a telepathic crystal skull located in Peru.

programme.title: Indiana Jones & Kingdom Of...
programme.desc: Berlatar belakang tahun 1957, film ini mempertemukan Indiana Jones dengan agen KGB Soviet yang dipimpin oleh Irina Spalko untuk mencari tengkorak kristal telepati yang terletak di Peru.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: WAKAKIBO KIDS
programme.desc: AT THE BASE OF BANANA MOUNTAIN, RIGHT ON THE EDGE OF A FANTASY TROPICAL FOREST FILLED WITH VARIOUS CUTE AND ADORABLE ANIMALS, LIES THE VILLAGE WHERE OUR TWO FRIENDS LIVE: WAKA AND KIBO. WAKA, A CHILD WHO LOVES TO EAT AND LOOKS LIKE A SLOW CHILD, IS ACTUALLY VERY CAREFUL AND ALWAYS THINKING BEFORE HE ACTS. ON THE OTHER HAND, KIBO, WITH HIS THICK, CURRY HAIR, IS A CHEERFUL FIGURE, ALWAYS CURIOS, AND EASY TO MAKE FRIENDS WITH ANYONE. UNLIKE WAKA, KIBO OFTEN ACTS WITHOUT THINKING FIRST. THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN WAKA AND KIBO IN THEIR VILLAGE FULL OF COLOUR AND LIFE TAKES US ON ENTERTAINING AND FASCINATING ADVENTURES, WHERE THESE TWO CHARACTERS LEARN FROM THEIR DIFFERENCES AND COMPLEMENT EACH OTHER.

programme.title: TITIPO TITIPO
programme.desc: LITTLE TRAIN TITIPO, NEWBORN IN CHOO CHOO TOWN, JUST PASSED HIS DRIVING EXAM AND IS READY TO WORK IN THE RAILWAY VILLAGE. ALTHOUGH TITIPO DREAMS OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN IN THE WORLD, HIS CURIOUS PERSONALITY ALWAYS LEADS HIM TO UNEXPECTED EVENTS AND PROBLEMS EVERY DAY. TITIPO EXPANDS HIS EXPERIENCE IN A BIGGER WORLD AND BECOMES FRIENDS WITH GENIE, DIESEL, AND OTHER LITTLE TRAINS. WILL TITIPO ACHIEVE HIS DREAM OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN? JOIN THE TRAIN JOURNEY AND MEET TITIPO AND THE LITTLE TRAIN FRIENDS.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: ABANG L THE EXPLORER

Abang L's funny antics, charm, and energy will bring this program to life. The articulate Abang L will ask questions to people around him. He will also try out several professions with the aim of educating viewers about each role.

programme.title: SHUKE AND BEITA

THESE FIVE CHILDREN HAVE UNIQUE AND DIFFERENT SUPERPOWERS. THEY USE THESE POWERS TO SOLVE VARIOUS CASES AND PROBLEMS THAT OCCUR AROUND THEM. IN ADDITION TO RESCUE MISSIONS, THEY ALSO HAVE TO FACE DAILY CONFLICTS AT SCHOOL, ESPECIALLY FROM THEIR ENEMY GANG, THE BEAST. THIS ANIMATION FOCUS ON THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP, COHESION, AND THE USE OF SUPERPOWERS FOR GOOD.

A WARM STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND A MORAL MESSAGE SUITABLE FOR ALL AGES.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.
